info.name: Associated Press Receive a feed of AP content items which have been sent to your organization's OnDemand queue.

params.name: consumer_id
params.description:
A user defined identifier for the consumer of this feed.
Each unique consumer ID will receive every item in your organization's OnDemand queue once.
If not specified, the API key of the request will be used.

params.name: queue
params.description: The ID of the desired queue.
